newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Italy's Stet up in N.Y. trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Italy's Stet up in N.Y. trade.

text.p: Stet SpA, the Italian state telecommunications holding company, rose Friday in New York trade as American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) enjoyed a rebound.
ADRs largely rose as foreign markets followed the Dow Jones Industrial Average higher. The Dow was up almost 60 points at mid-morning.
"All the (European) stocks are up since the European markets are up one percent," one trader said. "There's not much that is outstanding."
Stet was up 1-7/8 to 41-7/8 after the spinoff of its yellow pages producer Seat SpA. It began trade on the Milan exchange on Friday.
Among other European shares, Finnish telecom Nokia Group rose 7/8 to 57-3/8 and Dutch pharmaceutical company Akzo Nobel NV was up 1-1/2 to 68-7/8.
Israel's Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd rose three to 52-7/16 in heavy trade, helped by prospects for an Israeli-Palestinian accord on the West Bank city of Hebron.
Traders said Latin American stocks were boosted by renewed interest in the region at the start of the year.
Mexican stocks stood out in the rebound. Mexican bellwether Telefonos de Mexico was unchanged at 33-1/8.
Advancers led decliners 309 to 135 among an 807-ADR index. Volume was 26.7 million shares.
